knownDebt: Settings (P1-10): every TenantSetting key lives in features/settings/schemas.ts SETTINGS_REGISTRY (category/key/Zod/default/secret) — adding a setting is a registry row, never a migration. Secrets go through setSecretSettingAction and are AES-256-GCM `v1:` ciphertext at rest (lib/crypto); never return decrypted secrets to the client (readSecretState → hasValue + masked tail). security.* values are stored/validated but NOT yet enforced on the login path — P1-11 wires them.

Module-level state is NOT a singleton under Turbopack (Route Handlers / RSC / proxy each get their own copy, in production too). Cross-request state (caches, PrismaClient) must be registered on globalThis via Symbol.for keys — see lib/db/prisma.ts and lib/auth/tenant-resolver.ts; unit test imports the module twice (?instance=2) to prove sharing. Symptom before the fix: invalidateTenantCache() from /api/branding/logo never reached /login's copy; 3 connection pools per client.

Brand primary is text on dark surfaces: primaryColorSchema rejects colours where lib/color.primaryContrast(hex).min < 4.5 (binding surface = color-mix(primary 10%, card)). e2e/a11y.spec fails /dashboard on any lower-contrast primary. Zod 4 runs .refine even after .regex failed — guard refinements against malformed input.

users.academicIdFormat grammar (features/users/academic-id.ts): YYYY/YY = year, exactly one N-run = zero-padded sequence, everything else literal; only A-Z 0-9 - _ allowed. Braces are NOT placeholders. DEFAULT_ACADEMIC_ID_FORMAT is the single default (imported by SETTINGS_REGISTRY).

Tenant table has no RLS; app_user holds column-level UPDATE (name, nameEn, locale, timezone, updatedAt) only (migration 20260928140000). New tenant-editable Tenant columns need an explicit GRANT (scripts/gen-rls.ts) or fail with 42501.

Never import lib/auth/password.ts (argon2) from a client component — use lib/auth/password-policy.ts constants. ScrollRegion must stay `relative` (Radix hidden inputs otherwise inflate document.scrollHeight on mobile).

Audit (P1-09): AuditLog.actorId has no FK — resolve names with one IN(...) per page (features/audit/queries resolveActors); unknown id renders as 'deleted user'. Day filters are widened in the TENANT time zone (dayRangeInTimeZone) — never use Date-only comparisons. CSV cells pass csvEscape (formula-injection guard); export is keyset-paginated per short RLS tx, never one long transaction. The sheet is URL-addressable (?entry=<id>) so any page can deep-link an audit row.

Hydration (React #418): never format dates/numbers in client components with `new Intl.*(undefined)` or `useFormatter().dateTimeRange` — server (Node ICU, thin spaces U+2009) and browser output differ. Use `useFormatter().dateTime/number` and `lib/format-range.ts` for ranges. e2e/crawl.spec fails on any pageerror.

(useMediaQuery on DESKTOP_HEADER_QUERY). Do not add another h1 anywhere; crawl.spec asserts count == 1 on every route.
Both dashboard branches (mobile/desktop) are in the DOM; charts must mount only in the visible one (GrowthChart uses useMediaQuery) or Recharts logs width(0)/height(0).
CSP `upgrade-insecure-requests` is emitted only when x-forwarded-proto=https (proxy.ts). On plain http it made the browser upgrade redirects to https://localhost and fail.
Unauthenticated /api/* → 401 JSON `{ok:false,code:UNAUTHORIZED}` (proxy.ts), never a 307 to /login. Public API allow-list = /api/health + /api/auth/*.

Standalone pages outside the dashboard shell (/developer, /login, error pages) own their scroll: `<main class="h-dvh overflow-y-auto">` — the document itself must never scroll (ADR-0008 applies site-wide).

Bootstrap: prisma/seed.ts imports dotenv/config (tsx does not load .env); `prisma.config.ts` replaced package.json#prisma; NODE_ENV must NOT be in .env (exporting it breaks `next build`); pnpm override deepmerge-ts>=8 closes GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx.

Trash (P1-08): registry handlers must import permission predicates from has-permission.ts (vitest-loadable). Purge is FK-aware: parents referenced by live children (course←offerings/files, offering←files, user←uploadedFiles) come back as `blocked`, never as a thrown FK error — purge leaves first (PURGE_ORDER). e2e/trash.spec seeds rows directly via Prisma with `E2E`-prefixed codes and uses a per-run stamp in the search term (desktop+mobile runs share the DB).
PageTabs now has real ARIA tab semantics (role=tablist/tab, aria-selected, arrow keys). In e2e use getByRole('tab', …), not getByRole('button', …).

Viewport-locked shell (ADR-0008): every flex level between the page root and the list needs `min-h-0`, or the ScrollRegion grows instead of scrolling. Root = `flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col`; never `space-y-*` on a page root; verify with e2e `expectNoPageScroll`.

Mobile: PageHeader hides the in-content h1 below lg, so the app bar renders the h1 (ownsHeading). Detail pages that keep a visible h1 use MobilePageTitle instead. Never add a manual <header> — e2e heading assertions and axe page-has-heading-one depend on exactly one h1.

Unanchored .gitignore patterns bite: `storage` (P1-06) silently excluded app/src/lib/storage from every commit until PR #16. Anchor runtime dirs (`/storage/`) and run `git status --ignored` / a clean-clone `pnpm check` before merging a PR that adds a new top-level folder.
prettier --check flags ~120 pre-existing files; not part of `pnpm check`. Format ONLY files you touch (running --write on a folder pollutes the PR) or do a dedicated `style:` PR.
e2e logout test is fixme in auth.spec.ts.
Radix Select option tap is flaky on mobile-safari in Playwright; create dialogs are skipped on that project and asserted on desktop — mobile asserts list/detail/no-horizontal-scroll.
Modules imported by integration tests must import permission predicates from src/lib/auth/has-permission.ts, never runtime from rbac.ts (next-auth → next/server is not resolvable under vitest).
Never gate dev-only behaviour on NODE_ENV: `next start` (preview/sandbox) runs as production. Use an explicit env var (e.g. DEFAULT_TENANT_SLUG) instead.

AUTH_URL must stay UNSET (multi-tenant): Auth.js pins every redirect to that origin. Origins come from x-forwarded-host/proto normalised in proxy.ts via src/lib/auth/forwarded.ts; /api/auth route rebases request.url because `next start` builds it from the server hostname. When adding a new reverse proxy, echo its headers first (some send x-client-proto only).

Prisma enums in tests must be read from schema.prisma (UserStatus: PENDING_ACTIVATION/ACTIVE/FROZEN/DISABLED; EnrollmentStatus: ACTIVE/WITHDRAWN/COMPLETED); JSON columns are typed Prisma.InputJsonObject.
features/*/actions.ts imports `after` from next/server → never import actions in vitest; test core/scope/schemas/queries instead.
Background jobs (notification.fanout) run inline via after(); no standalone worker until P1-12 — a Job left PENDING after a crash is re-run by processFanoutJob.
Full Playwright run under load may fail login `toHaveURL` in roles/users specs; rerun those files alone before treating as regression.
